messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a cute, somewhat cartoonish SVG. Let me think about the composition: the bicycle (two wheels, frame, handlebars, seat, pedals), a pelican on top of the seat, with a large beak and pouch, wings gripping the handlebars, and legs on the pedals.

Let me design the coordinates. Canvas is 400x300.

Bicycle: wheels centered at (110, 230) and (290, 230), radius 40. Frame: connect them with lines. Seatpost goes to (185, 170), and the seat is above that. Handlebars at (255, 160).

Pelican: body perched on the seat, around (180, 140). An oval body, head circle around (215, 105), a big beak extending forward/downward with a pouch, and an eye. Wings extending to the handlebars. Legs going down to the pedals.

Let me write clean SVG code.

Wheels: outer circle with a stroke, and maybe include spokes too.

Frame polygon: bottom bracket (200, 230), seat tube going up to seat (185, 170), down tube to head tube (265, 170), rear end: seat (185,170) to rear wheel (110,230), chainstay (200,230) to (110,230), fork (265,170) to (290,230).

Handlebars: near (265, 160), curves.

Pedals: crank at bottom bracket, pedal circles at (200±20, 230±15).

Pelican: white body ellipse cx 175 cy 135 rx 40 ry 30, tail feathers on the left side, neck going up to the head, head circle at (220, 95) with radius 18. Beak: a long yellow-orange shape from the head to the right at (295, 110), with a pouch curve underneath it. Eye. Wing as a path from the shoulder to the handlebars at (262, 158). Leg: a line from the lower body to the pedal, orange, with a webbed foot.

Add motion lines, and maybe a sun too. Keep it simple but complete.
answer:

- 🌞 Motion lines, sun, and clouds for a sense of speed and cheerful atmosphere
